Company: Brightside Foods Co.

US mid-size packaged food company (~900 employees, plants in Ohio and Georgia). Makes hot dogs and sausages, brightly colored gummy candy, and pecan-and-apple snack bars. Buys pecans, apples and corn from US farms. Sells through grocery chains and convenience stores (many customers pay with SNAP / food stamps). Runs its own fleet of 40 delivery trucks. No restaurants, no alcohol, no exports.

Rules that APPLY:
- FDA food additive and color additive rules (dyes in candy, casings, meat)
- Food labeling and food safety rules for packaged food and meat products
- EPA pesticide residue limits on crops we buy (pecans, apples, corn)
- USDA marketing orders and grading for pecans and apples
- SNAP rules that change what shoppers can buy or who qualifies (affects demand)
- Workplace safety and labor rules for food plants; trucking safety rules for our fleet

Rules that DO NOT apply:
- Aviation, airspace, aircraft airworthiness
- Banking, securities, crypto, sanctions
- Medicare/Medicaid payment rules, medical devices
- Mining, offshore oil and gas, fisheries
- Broadcast/TV licensing

calls.prompt:
Company: Brightside Foods Co.

US mid-size packaged food company (~900 employees, plants in Ohio and Georgia). Makes hot dogs and sausages, brightly colored gummy candy, and pecan-and-apple snack bars. Buys pecans, apples and corn from US farms. Sells through grocery chains and convenience stores (many customers pay with SNAP / food stamps). Runs its own fleet of 40 delivery trucks. No restaurants, no alcohol, no exports.

Rules that APPLY:
- FDA food additive and color additive rules (dyes in candy, casings, meat)
- Food labeling and food safety rules for packaged food and meat products
- EPA pesticide residue limits on crops we buy (pecans, apples, corn)
- USDA marketing orders and grading for pecans and apples
- SNAP rules that change what shoppers can buy or who qualifies (affects demand)
- Workplace safety and labor rules for food plants; trucking safety rules for our fleet

Rules that DO NOT apply:
- Aviation, airspace, aircraft airworthiness
- Banking, securities, crypto, sanctions
- Medicare/Medicaid payment rules, medical devices
- Mining, offshore oil and gas, fisheries
- Broadcast/TV licensing

[2026-21658] Proposed Rule: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Electronic Benefits Transfer Card Security Measures
Tier: Critical (comment deadline in 60 days (< 90))
Owner: Aisha Grant (Sales Compliance)
Why relevant: Proposed SNAP EBT card security changes affect how SNAP shoppers pay at Brightside's grocery and convenience store customers, touching SNAP-driven sales.

[2026-21669] Proposed Rule: Hazard Analysis and Risk-Based Preventive Controls for Human Food; Draft Guidance for Industry; Availability
Tier: Medium (proposed rule, comment deadline in 90 days)
Owner: Maria Chen (Food Safety & Regulatory)
Why relevant: Draft chapter on control of chemical hazards under FDA preventive controls guidance bears on hazard analysis at Brightside's hot dog, gummy and snack bar plants.

actions.action: Have Aisha Grant review the proposed food stamp card security changes and decide whether to comment, since they could disrupt how shoppers pay at our retail customers.
Have Maria Chen compare FDA's draft guidance on chemical hazards with our plant food safety plans and decide whether to submit comments.
